headline: Iraq Rejects OPEC+ Production Capacity Estimate Ahead of Meeting
summary: Iraq is refusing an OPEC+ assessment that sets its sustainable production capacity below 5 million barrels per day. Baghdad is demanding recognition of 6 million barrels per day ahead of production target talks.
why: OPEC+ coordinates crude oil production targets among member states to regulate global supply and stabilize crude markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude Oil
impacts.why: Disagreements over official production capacities affect upcoming OPEC+ quota negotiations.
